notes:
Account background: BrightMetrics is a mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics + dashboards). Interested first in Redwood hosted API for quick ship of embeddings/search and chat summarization. After successful demo/POC they want Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation (customer data in VPC).

Key stakeholders: VP Product (Alyssa Brooks), Head of Platform (Tom Jansen), Procurement lead (Maria Ruiz), Security reviewer (Andre Gomez).

Demo & POC highlights:
- 2026-01-12: Intro demo (hosted) - quick wins on embeddings for cross-report search. Product team liked latency and token-cost visibility.
- 2026-01-19: Technical deep-dive with SE (Priya) - discussed batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs. SE recommended dedicated GPUs for large concurrent workloads.
- 2026-01-22 to 2026-02-05: 2-week POC on hosted -> results: embeddings throughput ~120 qps, median response for search ~85ms, chat p95 ~450ms on hosted. POC used open embedding model + Redwood prefix caching.
- POC conclusion: quality & cost acceptable; ops team flagged variability at peak and requested Dedicated for steady SLA-backed throughput.

Pricing & procurement discussions:
- Initial pricing proposal sent 2026-02-08 (refer Pricing Deck). Suggested committed monthly capacity for Dedicated with burst headroom.
- Expected ARR range anchored at $50k-$150k/year depending on commit level and support SLAs.
- Procurement wants MSA + DPA redline discussion before moving to PO.

Legal / Security asks from customer:
- MSA: caps on downtime, explicit SLA terms for Dedicated (99.9% uptime target), definitions for scheduled maintenance vs unplanned outages, credits calculation.
- DPA: retention period controls, right to audit, data residency clauses (US only), encryption at rest with customer KMS, breach notification timelines.
- Security: require SOC2 Type II report, SSO via SAML/Okta, audit logging export, contract language about sub-processors.

Quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We liked the platform UI and cost visibility — but legal needs clearer SLA numbers for Dedicated before we sign." — VP Product (Alyssa)
- "If we can't get a VPC-backed Dedicated deployment with KMS and explicit uptime credits, Procurement will push back." — Procurement (Maria)

Next legal steps / redlines in flight:
- 2026-02-18: Legal sent initial redlines to Redwood (attached Security-FAQ link). Key asks: lower indemnity threshold, stricter data deletion clause, 30-day notice windows for changes.
- 2026-02-22: Redwood legal responded with counter-redlines; awaiting internal review at BrightMetrics (target response due 2026-02-28).

Open technical follow-ups:
- Provide Dedicated performance SLOs (p50/p95 token latency) for their expected config (8xA100 equivalent), include cold-start behavior and cache warming guidance.
- Confirm network topology diagram for VPC peering and egress controls (requested by Andre).
- Provide runbook for incident escalation and 24/7 support contact for enterprise SLA.

Risk / next steps summary:
- High technical fit; biggest friction is procurement/legal (MSA/DPA redlines + SLA).
- Sales next step: AE to push final redlines to their GC, confirm PO timeline and arrive at mutual SLA credit formula. SE to deliver Dedicated SLO doc and network diagram. Security to hand off SOC2 artifacts.

Suggested playbook: expedite legal call (30-min) with Redwood Legal + BrightMetrics GC + AE + SE in next 3 business days; provide final Dedicated price + SLO appendix to attach to MSA.
